translations./__body:
The journey begins in the Andean highlands and Colombia's capital. In Bogotá, explore La Candelaria, visit its museums and ascend Monserrate. The following day combines Lake Guatavita with the Salt Cathedral of Zipaquirá.

A flight to Cartagena changes the scenery: colonial streets, city walls and the Caribbean Sea await. A day in the Rosario Islands leaves time to swim and relax.

## Accommodation and prices

All rates are in USD per person, by occupancy.

| Category | Bogotá, 2 nights | Cartagena, 2 nights | SGL | DBL | TRP |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4★ | Best Western Plus 93 Park Hotel | Dann Cartagena | $3,480 | $1,883 | $1,863 |
| 5★ | Bogotá Marriott Hotel | Hyatt Regency Cartagena | $4,100 | $2,312 | $2,158 |

SGL means single occupancy; DBL, double occupancy; and TRP, triple occupancy. Rates include services with English-speaking guides. The domestic flight from Bogotá to Cartagena and international flights are not included. Exact travel dates and rate applicability are confirmed at booking.
